summary: The player fights the boss (The Warden), dodging sweeping arcs of pink bullets while scanning it with a wide white cone. The player releases a charged shot that hits the boss, then moves right and left while continuing to scan and dodge.

events.evidence: Wide white scanning arc projects from player ship onto boss; 'Scanning' bar fills at top.
Player ship stops moving left and moves right.
Three yellow charge bars empty as a wide glowing arc is fired upward with a whoosh/zap sound.
Expanding yellow rings on the boss and a heavy impact sound.
Player ship moves further to the right side of the lane.
Player ship reverses from right to left to dodge incoming bullet arc.

readability_issues.issue: The bright white leading edge of the scanning cone overlaps with the pink enemy bullets, briefly reducing their contrast.
The bright glow around the player ship when charging/firing makes it slightly harder to judge the exact hitbox against nearby pink bullets.
